vb_textbox.text: In order to maximise your likelihood of performing well in this experiment, try to memorise the performance of each of the gnomes across the experiment. While the gnomes have good and bad days, and this can reflect in their performance, in general, there are certain gnomes that perform better than others, and selecting these as often as you can will maximise your performance in the task. Once you've tried a few rounds of the experiment, you should develop a memory for which ones perform better, and although you won't be perfect every time, you should start finding once you've been doing the experiment for a while that you're automatically selecting the best performing gnome the majority of the time.
